name: Chesa Auto
description: Telegram auto-play bot for the @GameFactoryBot Chesa (chess) webapp. Opens the webapp and plays every move automatically with an expert-level alpha-beta engine to maximize wins.

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram user ID (numeric). Get it from @userinfobot.

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Telegram chat ID (numeric) where logs are sent. Add the bot as admin there.

UPDATE_CHANNEL.description: Update channel username (with @) for force-sub. e.g. @YourChannel

UPDATE_CHANNEL_LINK.description: https://t.me/YourUpdateChannel link for the join button

GAME_BOT_USERNAME.description: The game bot to open (default GameFactoryBot)

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Your Heroku app name (used to build the webapp URL). e.g. chesa-auto
